title: ork status lists stale manual relays

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: A manual relay (slicer relay-run) with no event for 30 minutes drops out of 'slicer relay-run list --active', so ork status printed 'active relays 0' while the S254 run was open. The TUI board already shows stale runs from BoardRuns (internal/source/source.go:365); ork status (internal/daemon/handlers.go:430-437, internal/cli/daemoncmds.go:62) does not. Show stale runs in status, marked stale, from the same BoardRuns data. Failing test: a snapshot with one stale run yields an ActiveRelays entry with state stale; the status line counts it.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/daemon/handlers.go:304` (status board read) and `internal/daemon/handlers.go:392` (projectStatus)
- `internal/daemon/daemon_test.go:1457` (TestProjectStatusStaleRelays)
- `internal/daemon/board_review_test.go:25` (TestStatusAndSnapshotReadBoard)
- `internal/cli/daemoncmds.go:62-85` (status output; reference only)
- `internal/cli/cli_test.go:1269` (TestStatusStaleRelays) and `internal/cli/cli_test.go:807` (TestDoctorCheckCommandSyntaxError; reported check failure)
- `internal/source/source.go:365` (Direct.BoardRuns; reference only)
- `docs/guide.md:345`
- `docs/design.md:2032` (status active_relays definition)
- `CHANGELOG.md:3`

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestProjectStatusStaleRelays: a snapshot with one stale and one ended BoardRuns entry returns exactly the stale Relay, including its state and fields; adding one active Runs entry retains both and the active running step.
- TestStatusAndSnapshotReadBoard: status reads board data and returns the stale relay, excluding ended runs; snapshot retains its existing board read.
- TestStatusStaleRelays/stale: through the daemon, status prints exactly active relays 1 and the stale row ending stale (3 steps, 0 running), excluding the ended run.
- TestStatusStaleRelays/mixed: changing only the active Runs input lists active and stale rows, keeps the active running-step line, and counts both.
- Fix-round check failure: TestDoctorCheckCommandSyntaxError checks the real shell diagnostic without depending on its capitalization; run the project check directly so this assertion does not require a daemon socket.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. In the status builder, after the Runs loop, append each BoardRuns run whose state is "stale" as a Relay, built the same way (share the loop body).
2. The CLI line already prints State; keep the count including stale runs.
3. Note in docs/guide.md that status lists stale manual relays, and add a CHANGELOG bullet.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l .`, `slicer check`, `adj lint`.
- No internal/tui change, so no UI pass; ork status output gains only the stale state word.
